_help: Test-support settings. reserved_buses: the simulated school day never runs these buses (testers run them by hand, every day). actions: one-off actions applied once per database on that date.
_today_start_help: zero = every day starts with all totals 0 except students enrolled (previous days keep their full data). simulate = the demo school day plays automatically. Setup -> Demo tools -> replay still plays today on demand.
